title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
abstract: arXiv:2610.30026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. translated_title: 作者所写与智能体所读：企业文档摄取中的静默线索丢失
translated_abstract: 企业智能体基于文档采取行动。在智能体能够遵循某项政策、回答合规问题或提交工单之前，某个摄取层必须先将Word文件或PDF转换为令牌（token）——而正是这一层面导致部署在真实环境中的智能体悄然丢失信息。我们证明，每一款主流转换器都会丢失一个层面的信息——即作者通过文本外观所编码的含义——并且这种丢失使智能体“自信地犯错”而非“明显地不完整”。我们基于76份真实政策文档构建了一项任务：恢复作者特别标出的要求，并采用一个无需LLM评判的确定性匹配器、依据文件自身的OOXML属性进行评分。对格式“视而不见”的摄取方式使微观F1从0.690骤降至0.150（docling）和0.075（纯文本），这一差距在来自两家供应商的六个回答模型中均得到复现——涵盖Opus、Sonnet和Haiku三个层级的五个Claude模型，以及OpenAI的GPT-5.6。无法看到线索的智能体只能靠猜测作答，而文档……
tldr: 该研究揭示了企业文档摄取环节中所有主流转换器都会丢失作者通过文本格式编码的含义，导致来自两家供应商的六个大模型智能体在恢复作者重点标注要求的任务上性能从F1 0.690骤降至0.075-0.150，且这种失败表现为“自信地给出错误答案”而非“明显的不完整”。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that every mainstream document converter silently discards the meaning authors encode through text formatting, causing six LLM agents from two vendors to collapse from micro F1 0.690 to 0.075-0.150 on recovering author-highlighted requirements—failing by being confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete.
